title: Cellulose nanofiber-scaffolded rGO/WO3 membrane for photocatalytic degradation of methylene blue under visible light irradiation
content:

The rGO/WO3 nanoparticles and cellulose nanofiber (CNF) cohered in the membrane. Methylene blue (MB) dye was removed rapidly by the CNF/rGO/WO3 photocatalytic membrane materials.
